name: lcs-identical
checks: Equal strings: the diagonal branch is taken at every step.

name: lcs-no-common
checks: No shared characters: wrong base case or reconstruction loop would emit garbage.

name: lcs-classic
checks: Non-contiguous optimum with mismatch transitions on both sides.

name: lcs-both-empty
checks: Both inputs empty.

name: merge-two
checks: Smallest non-trivial interval; plan has exactly n-1 = 1 merge.

name: merge-adjacency
checks: Optimum 404 = (1+100)+(1+100)+202; a greedy merge of the two smallest (non-adjacent) blocks violates adjacency.

name: tree-single
checks: Single vertex, no edges.

name: tree-star
checks: Leaves beat the centre (15 vs 1); take/skip at the root.

name: tree-chain-four
checks: Reconstruction must respect the parent decision (0 and 3, not 1 and 3).

name: tree-inner-optimum
checks: Best vertex is not vertex 0 and edges are listed child-first: detects dependence on root or edge direction.

name: naive-no-match
checks: No occurrence.

name: naive-whole-text
checks: Last valid start equals 0 when pattern length equals text length.

name: kmp-fallback
checks: Several partial matches that need prefix-function fallback before the real match.

name: kmp-period
checks: Fallback after a full match keeps the periodic occurrences.

name: rk-hash-equal-not-match
checks: 'dj' and 'ab' both hash to 75 (base 31, mod 101): reporting on equal hash alone would also return 0.

name: rk-rolling
checks: Many rolling updates, including negative remainders after subtracting the leftmost character.

name: suffix-distinct
checks: No repeated substring: repeated must be the empty string.

name: suffix-mississippi
checks: Several doubling rounds and Kasai reuse; the unique maximum LCP 4 gives 'issi'.

name: aho-nested
checks: Patterns that are prefixes/suffixes of each other; failure-link propagation.

name: aho-overlap
checks: Overlapping matches are all counted.

name: aho-duplicates
checks: Duplicate patterns share a state but keep separate columns; empty text gives zeros.

name: aho-reset
checks: Automaton state must reset between texts: 'a' then 'b' must not form 'ab'.
